meta.source: Janelia FlyEM hemibrain, compact connection matrix summary (traced adjacencies) and skeletons
meta.release: hemibrain v1.2 (neuPrint dataset hemibrain:v1.2, bulk export 2020-12-22)
meta.citation: Scheffer LK et al. (2020) eLife 9:e57443, doi:10.7554/eLife.57443
meta.hemisphere: right (the complete MB in the hemibrain volume)
meta.units: micrometres; hemibrain voxel 8 nm; pos = soma (largest-radius skeleton node, radius >= 1.2 um) or the centroid when posSoma is 0; cen = cable-weighted skeleton centroid
notes: Wiring is the real hemibrain v1.2 synapse counts between the selected neurons, filtered by the thresholds above.
MBON valence is a model rule: +1 for PPL1-dominated compartments, -1 for PAM-dominated, 0 for ties and the calyx. It is not a per-cell measurement.
dan_mbon_compartment pairs a DAN with an MBON when their Aso 2014 compartments overlap (names parsed from hemibrain instance names). dan_mbon_syn holds the real DAN->MBON synapse counts.
KCs with no uniglomerular PN input (for example KCab-p and KCg-d, which get mostly visual input) stay in the set with no pn_kc edges.
v1.2.1 exists only as a neuPrint dataset; the public bulk export without a neuPrint token is v1.2, so this file uses v1.2.
